name: gin-skills
description: Install GinStudio skills and agents for Claude Code

scripts.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy landing --project-name ginskill --branch main
scripts.release: node scripts/gen-readme.mjs && git add -A && git diff-index --quiet HEAD || git commit -m "chore: pre-release" && npm version patch && npm publish && git push && git push --tags && npm run deploy
scripts.release:minor: node scripts/gen-readme.mjs && git add -A && git diff-index --quiet HEAD || git commit -m "chore: pre-release" && npm version minor && npm publish && git push && git push --tags && npm run deploy
scripts.release:major: node scripts/gen-readme.mjs && git add -A && git diff-index --quiet HEAD || git commit -m "chore: pre-release" && npm version major && npm publish && git push && git push --tags && npm run deploy
